SD44-X02.name: The DarkKingMachineBeast Darkness-Griffon X
SD44-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Besides [Soul Core], you can send two cores from your Trash to one of your White Grandwalker Nexuses. Also, discard an opposing Burst.
[Rush: God]
(While you have a God symbol, the effect below activates next)
[Core]: Return two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.
[Rush: God]
(While you have a God symbol, the effect below activates next.)
[Core]: You can draw a card.

SD44-X01.name: The DragonShineDeity Shining-Dragon-Overray X
SD44-X01.effect:
While your Life is three or less, this card becomes Cost 6.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Every "Fencer" family Spirit you control can brave with up to two Braves.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When any opposing Spirit is destroyed, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit. Also, while you control any Red Grandwalker Nexus, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

SD44-004.name: The FlyingBladeSwordsman Edgemaster
SD44-004.effect:
[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Red Core]: Draw a card.

SD44-001.name: Bolide-Dragon
SD44-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains two extra White symbols.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by Opponent)
Put a core from Void to any of your White-only Grandwalker Nexus.

SD44-005.name: Darkness-Cocadrille
SD44-005.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core][Core])]
Return an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom. When any Spirit is returned to the deckbottom by this effect, put a core from Void to any Red-only Grandwalker Nexus you control. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on your Removed Zone.

SD44-010.name: Edge Dream
SD44-010.effect:
[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Then, reveal four cards from your decktop. Deploy an exactly-named "Tsurugi Tatewaki"/"The Midnight Sun King Yaiba" among them, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

SD44-009.name: Shining Burst
SD44-009.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Main effect.

[Main]
Draw a card. When activated via the Burst effect, instead, draw two cards.

SD44-006.name: The DarknessSwordMaster Total Eclipse
SD44-006.effect:
While your Life is three or less, this card becomes Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Refresh all your "Fencer"/"Machine Beast" family Spirits.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Your "Fencer"/"Machine Beast" family Spirits can't be blocked by opposing 7000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates.

SD44-007.name: The Dragon Shooting Station
SD44-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When any opposing Spirit is destroyed, draw a card.

SD44-008.name: The Great Iceblade Cave
SD44-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Besides via Burst effects, when the opponent summons any Spirit without paying the cost, for each Spirit summoned, put one core from Void to your Life.

[LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing Spirit/Magic effect, for each card increased, you can draw a card.

SD44-003.name: The LightSwordMaster Grandcross-Dragon
SD44-003.effect:
While your Life is three or less, this card becomes Cost 4.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
All your "Fencer" family Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.
[Rush: God]
(While you have a God symbol, the following effect activates next.)
[Core]: At the end of battle, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11409.name: The Midnight Sun King Yaiba
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11409.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Machine Beast/Fencer/Worldswalker & Cost 3 or more) (Exalted Sword & Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Send 4 cores from this Nexus to Void) Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
Besides via Burst effects, when the opponent summons any Spirit/Brave without paying the cost, put four cores from Void to this Nexus.

SD44-002.name: The SunGuardian Aureole-Dragon
SD44-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Cost 3 or less Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on Field in exhausted state.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Besides via Burst effects, neither player can summon Spirit cards without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be returned to the Hand/deck by opposing effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13929.name: Tsurugi Tatewaki (Card)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13929.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Astral Dragon/Fencer/Worldswalker & Cost 3 or more) (Exalted Sword & Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Turn)
(Send two core from this Nexus to the Void) Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
Increase the limit of this Nexus's "BP Destruction effect" by +10000. Also, increase the limit of your Spirit/Magic/Grandwalker Nexus's "BP Destruction effects", other than this Nexus', by +5000.
